prompt: Fix the agentic Popover in packages/agentic/components/src/components/popover so pressing its trigger while the popover is open dismisses it with the 'trigger' reason. Keep your edit-and-check loop fast, and validate the finished change.

assertions.description: Checks each edit with a component selector such as `yarn test popover` from the package, not the whole package suite, `yarn lage buildci`, or a direct `jest` call.
Type-checks any change to `popover.types.ts` or its `*.types.test.ts` with `yarn build`, because a Jest pass does not cover types.
Runs the whole package suite before handover and `yarn clean-lage-cache` then `yarn lage buildci` once at the end, and reports the focused and full-suite results separately.
